facts.text: Henry Dorsett Case is the protagonist of Neuromancer.
Henry Dorsett Case is the protagonist of William Gibson's first novel, Neuromancer.
Henry Dorsett Case is the first installment of the Sprawl Trilogy.
Henry Dorsett Case is an antihero.
Henry Dorsett Case is introduced as a drug addict.
Henry Dorsett Case is introduced as a former cyberspace hacker.
Armitage offers to cure Henry Dorsett Case in exchange for Henry Dorsett Case's hacking abilities.
Henry Dorsett Case warily accepts Armitage's offer.
